name: Intervals
summary: Sort by start, then scan once while deciding whether the current interval overlaps, extends, or is contained. Interval problems are sorting problems with a merge decision attached.
signal: meetings, schedules, overlap, merge, insert, ranges, start/end
mentalModel: SORT FIRST, then SCAN, then ask OVERLAP?, then MERGE.
recognitionRules: Input is a list of start/end pairs.
You must find how many rooms or meetings are needed.
You must remove the minimum number of intervals so nothing overlaps.
You must insert a new interval into an already sorted schedule.
template: if merged is empty or interval.start > last(merged).end:
invariant: merged holds the disjoint answer for everything processed so far, in sorted order.
